get.description:
Search songs with optional filters.

Theme/classification are exact-match after lowercasing so case
variants collapse into a single bucket. Year range is bounded
by ``year_from <= year_to``; the helper raises 400 if inverted.

The ``q`` parameter is also exposed as ``query`` so the existing
Vue dashboard (which sends ``?query=...``) keeps working
without a frontend change.

get.description:
Top ``limit`` most-frequent non-stop-word tokens across the catalog.

Defaults to 200 words (the 500-word all-catalog view produced too
much crowding — reviewer feedback 01/jul/2026). The dashboard can
request more via ``?limit=500`` if needed. Theme / classification
/ album / year filters mirror the same filter pipeline as
``/api/search`` and ``/api/stats`` so the dashboard word cloud
updates when the user narrows the year range or toggles a chip.

AuthResponse.title: AuthResponse
AuthResponse.description:
The /api/auth/{login,register,refresh} envelope.

Includes the access-token JWT so the Vue dashboard can stash it
in localStorage (matching the Go contract).

PaginatedResponse.title: PaginatedResponse
PaginatedResponse.description: Generic pagination envelope for /api/admin/* list endpoints.

SongCreateIn.title: SongCreateIn
SongCreateIn.description:
Request body for ``POST /api/admin/songs``.

Only the create-time fields are required; the ``id`` and the
timestamp columns come from the database.

SongOut.title: SongOut
SongOut.description:
One row in the public catalog + admin song endpoints.

Flat shape: every fonograma field the UI needs (album title,
subtítulo, intérpretes, año, editora, …) is exposed at the
top level so the frontend can render a single ``Song`` object
without an extra fetch. The JOIN against ``fonogramas`` lives
in the public/admin routers.

SongUpdateIn.title: SongUpdateIn
SongUpdateIn.description:
Request body for ``PUT /api/admin/songs/{id}``.

Only the editable fields are exposed; the existing ``id`` /
``fonograma_id`` / ``created_at`` are read from the database.
Mirrors the Go PUT semantics: only non-empty fields are
persisted, matching its gorm.UpdateColumns-on-non-empty contract.

UserCreatedResponse.title: UserCreatedResponse
UserCreatedResponse.description: Generic 200/201 envelope used by PUT / DELETE.

UserUpdateIn.title: UserUpdateIn
UserUpdateIn.description:
PATCH-style update. All fields are optional; only non-empty
ones are written (matches the Go PUT behaviour).

app__schemas__auth__UserOut.title: UserOut
app__schemas__auth__UserOut.description:
The shape the Vue dashboard expects.

The ``token`` field on the response is the access-token JWT; the
cookie carries it too, but mirroring it in the body keeps the
Go-era dashboard functional without requiring it to read
``document.cookie``.
